"""Ciel Vision Router (Langflow custom component).

Menggantikan node Ollama "Vision Preprocessor" yang sebelumnya berada
di antara Chat Input dan Agent.

Masalah desain lama:
- Seluruh teks pesan (termasuk konteks file proyek) dikirim ke model
  vision lokal yang konteksnya hanya 4096 token, sehingga pesan panjang
  gagal dengan "request exceeds the available context size".
- Agent hanya menerima output model vision, bukan pertanyaan asli.
- Pesan tanpa gambar tetap diproses model vision di CPU.

Perilaku baru:
- Tanpa gambar: teks diteruskan apa adanya, tanpa memanggil model vision.
- Ada gambar: model vision hanya menerima gambar + instruksi pendek, lalu
  hasil bacaannya digabung dengan pertanyaan asli untuk Agent.
- Jika model vision gagal, Agent tetap menerima pertanyaan beserta
  keterangan bahwa gambar tidak terbaca (tidak menjatuhkan seluruh flow).

Sejak v1.10.0: jika Vision API Key diisi, gambar dibaca lewat Gemini API
(cepat), dan model lokal hanya dipakai bila API gagal atau terlalu lama.
Model lokal di CPU laptop butuh ~66 dtk per foto baru (uji 2026-10-18).
"""

import asyncio

import requests
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, SystemMessage
from langchain_ollama import ChatOllama
from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import IntInput, MessageInput, MessageTextInput, MultilineInput, Output, SecretStrInput
from langflow.schema.message import Message

GEMINI_URL = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent"


def gemini_parts(images):
    """Gemini inline_data parts from Langflow image dicts ({"image_url": {"url": "data:<mime>;base64,<data>"}})."""
    parts = []
    for item in images:
        url = (item.get("image_url") or {}).get("url") or item.get("url") or ""
        header, _, data = url.partition(",")
        if not header.startswith("data:") or ";base64" not in header or not data:
            raise ValueError("gambar bukan data URL base64")
        parts.append({"inline_data": {"mime_type": header[5:].split(";")[0], "data": data}})
    return parts


def gemini_text(response_json):
    parts = ((response_json.get("candidates") or [{}])[0].get("content") or {}).get("parts") or []
    text = "".join(part.get("text", "") for part in parts if not part.get("thought")).strip()
    if not text:
        raise ValueError("Gemini tidak mengembalikan teks")
    return text

DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """Kamu adalah Vision Preprocessor universal.

TUGAS:
Baca dan ekstrak informasi yang terlihat pada gambar.
Kamu hanya membaca isi gambar.
Jangan menyelesaikan soal.
Jangan memberikan jawaban atau analisis.

ATURAN OUTPUT:
1. Gunakan teks biasa.
2. Jangan gunakan LaTeX.
3. Jangan menggunakan karakter backslash "\\".
4. Jangan menggunakan $, $$, \\frac, \\lim, \\sqrt, \\boxed, \\text, \\begin, atau \\end.
5. Pertahankan angka, simbol, rumus, tabel, dan struktur informasi.
6. Gunakan Unicode seperti → × ÷ √ ≤ ≥ ≠ ∪ ∩ ∈.
7. Untuk pecahan gunakan format (pembilang) / (penyebut).
8. Jangan menebak informasi yang tidak terlihat.
9. Jangan menyelesaikan soal.
10. Jika bagian gambar tidak terbaca, nyatakan secara eksplisit."""

IMAGE_HEADER = "### Isi gambar terlampir (dibaca otomatis oleh model vision)"


class CielVisionRouter(Component):
    display_name = "Ciel Vision Router"
    description = (
        "Meneruskan pesan teks langsung ke Agent. Jika ada gambar, gambar "
        "dibaca model vision lalu hasilnya digabung dengan pertanyaan asli."
    )
    icon = "eye"
    name = "CielVisionRouter"

    inputs = [
        MessageInput(name="message", display_name="Message", required=True),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="model_name",
            display_name="Vision Model",
            value="qwen2.5vl:3b",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="base_url",
            display_name="Ollama Base URL",
            value="http://127.0.0.1:11434",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="system_prompt",
            display_name="Vision System Prompt",
            value=DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="instruction",
            display_name="Vision Instruction",
            value="Baca dan ekstrak semua informasi yang terlihat pada gambar ini.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="num_ctx",
            display_name="Vision Context Window",
            value=4096,
            advanced=True,
            info="Cukup untuk gambar + instruksi; teks pesan tidak dikirim ke model vision.",
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="vision_api_key",
            display_name="Vision API Key (Gemini)",
            value="",
            required=False,
            info="Kosong = selalu pakai model lokal. Pakai key dari project berbayar: tier gratis memakai data untuk melatih model.",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="api_model",
            display_name="Vision API Model",
            value="gemini-3.1-flash-lite",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="api_fallback_model",
            display_name="Vision API Model Cadangan",
            value="gemini-3.5-flash-lite",
            advanced=True,
            info="Dicoba jika model utama gagal (misalnya HTTP 503), sebelum model lokal.",
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="api_timeout",
            display_name="Vision API Timeout (detik)",
            value=20,
            advanced=True,
            info="Batas per model API; setelah semua gagal, gambar dibaca model lokal.",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="routed_message", method="route"),
    ]

    def _image_contents(self, message: Message) -> list[dict]:
        if not message.files:
            return []

        probe = Message(
            text=self.instruction,
            sender="User",
            files=list(message.files),
            flow_id=message.flow_id,
        )
        contents = probe.get_file_content_dicts(self.model_name)
        return [item for item in contents if item.get("type") in ("image", "image_url")]

    async def route(self) -> Message:
        message = self.message
        text = message.text if isinstance(message.text, str) else ""

        images = self._image_contents(message)

        if not images:
            self.status = "Tanpa gambar: pesan diteruskan langsung."
            return Message(text=text)

        # Production 2026-10-18: gemini-3.1-flash-lite answered HTTP 503 for a
        # while; the local model then took 136 s. Another Gemini model usually
        # still works, so try it before the local model.
        api_errors = []
        if self.vision_api_key:
            models = [m for m in dict.fromkeys((self.api_model, self.api_fallback_model)) if m]
            for model in models:
                try:
                    reading = await asyncio.to_thread(self._read_with_api, images, model)
                    self.status = f"{len(images)} gambar dibaca lewat {model}."
                    return Message(text=f"{text}\n\n{IMAGE_HEADER}\n{reading}")
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - coba model berikutnya
                    api_errors.append(f"{model}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}"[:200])

        reading = await self._read_locally(images)
        if api_errors:
            self.status = f"Vision API gagal ({'; '.join(api_errors)}); {self.status}"
        return Message(text=f"{text}\n\n{IMAGE_HEADER}\n{reading}")

    def _read_with_api(self, images, model) -> str:
        response = requests.post(
            GEMINI_URL.format(model=model),
            headers={"x-goog-api-key": str(self.vision_api_key)},
            json={
                "system_instruction": {"parts": [{"text": self.system_prompt}]},
                "contents": [{"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": self.instruction}, *gemini_parts(images)]}],
                "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.1},
            },
            timeout=self.api_timeout,
        )
        if response.status_code != 200:
            # Isi error tanpa key; status cukup untuk melacak masalah billing/kuota.
            raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {response.status_code}")
        return gemini_text(response.json())

    async def _read_locally(self, images) -> str:
        llm = ChatOllama(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            model=self.model_name,
            num_ctx=self.num_ctx,
            temperature=0.1,
        )

        try:
            result = await llm.ainvoke(
                [
                    SystemMessage(content=self.system_prompt),
                    HumanMessage(content=[{"type": "text", "text": self.instruction}, *images]),
                ]
            )
            reading = result.content if isinstance(result.content, str) else str(result.content)
            reading = reading.strip() or "(Model vision tidak menemukan teks atau informasi pada gambar.)"
            self.status = f"{len(images)} gambar dibaca."
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - lanjutkan tanpa gambar daripada menggagalkan flow
            reading = f"(Gambar tidak dapat dibaca oleh model vision: {type(error).__name__}: {error})"
            self.status = reading

        return reading

"""Ciel Exa Search (Langflow custom component).

Same inputs and tools as the official Exa Search toolkit, plus a record of
every URL Exa returns during the run, kept in the graph context. Ciel Source
Guard reads that record to drop sources the Research Agent did not get from
a search.

The record comes from Exa's responses themselves, not from the Agent's
message events, so the guard does not depend on how Langflow logs tool calls.
In 9 probe runs (2026-10-17) both agreed: 2 searches, 10 URLs each time.
"""

from langchain_core.tools import StructuredTool
from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.field_typing import Tool
from lfx_exa.components.exa.exa_search import ExaSearchToolkit

# Same key in ciel_source_guard.py (components cannot import each other).
RETRIEVED_URLS_KEY = "ciel_retrieved_urls"


def result_urls(response):
    """URLs of an Exa search or get_contents response, in result order."""
    return [str(item.url) for item in getattr(response, "results", None) or [] if getattr(item, "url", None)]


# Component is listed explicitly: Langflow finds a component class by its
# written bases, and ExaSearchToolkit already derives from Component.
class CielExaSearch(ExaSearchToolkit, Component):
    display_name = "Ciel Exa Search"
    description = (
        "Exa search untuk Research Agent. Sama seperti Exa Search, ditambah catatan URL "
        "yang benar-benar dikembalikan Exa untuk dicek Ciel Source Guard."
    )
    name = "CielExaSearch"

    def build_toolkit(self) -> Tool:
        retrieved = self.ctx.setdefault(RETRIEVED_URLS_KEY, [])

        def recorded(original):
            def run(**kwargs):
                response = original.func(**kwargs)
                retrieved.extend(result_urls(response))
                return response

            return StructuredTool.from_function(
                func=run,
                name=original.name,
                description=original.description,
                args_schema=original.args_schema,
            )

        return [recorded(item) for item in super().build_toolkit()]

"""Ciel Source Guard (Langflow custom component).

Sits between the Agent and Chat Output of the main flow (v1.9.0, where the
Agent searches with Ciel Exa Search itself). When the run searched, it removes
every line under "Sumber:" whose URLs Ciel Exa Search did not return, the [n]
markers of those entries, and findings whose only markers pointed at removed
entries. One line at the end says how many sources were removed.

It never adds other text. Answers from runs without a search pass through
unchanged, and so do source lines without a URL (an attached file, the
Knowledge Base). The Agent message is filtered in place, block by block,
because the app shows the last text block of the message. Text from earlier
Agent rounds is dropped so the stored answer is the final answer only.

Why: with few search results the research agent sometimes listed sources from
memory (live test 2026-10-17: hai.stanford.edu pages and numbers that a
retrieved article only mentioned by name). Prompt rules reduced this but did
not stop it.
"""

import re

from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import MessageInput, Output
from langflow.schema.message import Message

# Same key in ciel_exa_search.py (components cannot import each other).
RETRIEVED_URLS_KEY = "ciel_retrieved_urls"

SOURCES_HEADING = re.compile(r"^\W*sumber\W*$", re.IGNORECASE)
SOURCE_ENTRY = re.compile(r"^\W*\[(\d+)\]")
MARKER = re.compile(r"\[(\d+(?:\s*,\s*\d+)*)\]")
URL = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\"'\[\]]+")


def cited_urls(line):
    """URLs in a line; a closing parenthesis is kept only when the URL opened one (Markdown links)."""
    urls = []
    for url in URL.findall(line):
        while url.endswith(")") and url.count(")") > url.count("("):
            url = url[:-1]
        urls.append(url)
    return urls


def normalize_url(url):
    url = url.strip().lower().split("#", 1)[0]
    url = re.sub(r"^https?://", "", url)
    url = re.sub(r"^www\.", "", url)
    return url.rstrip("/.,;:*_")


def strip_markers(line, removed):
    """Line without markers of removed entries, and whether only removed ones were cited."""
    cited = kept = 0

    def replace(match):
        nonlocal cited, kept
        numbers = [n.strip() for n in match.group(1).split(",")]
        cited += len(numbers)
        remaining = [n for n in numbers if n not in removed]
        kept += len(remaining)
        return f"[{', '.join(remaining)}]" if remaining else ""

    new_line = MARKER.sub(replace, line)
    if new_line != line:
        new_line = re.sub(r"(?<=\S)[ \t]{2,}", " ", new_line)
        new_line = re.sub(r"[ \t]+([.,;:])", r"\1", new_line).rstrip()
    return new_line, cited > 0 and kept == 0


def filter_sources(text, retrieved_urls):
    """(checked text, number of removed sources). Without retrieved URLs nothing was searched."""
    lines = text.splitlines()
    heading = next((i for i in range(len(lines) - 1, -1, -1) if SOURCES_HEADING.match(lines[i])), None)
    if heading is None or not retrieved_urls:
        return text, 0

    known = {normalize_url(url) for url in retrieved_urls}
    removed_numbers = set()
    removed_lines = 0
    sources = []
    for line in lines[heading + 1:]:
        urls = cited_urls(line)
        if urls and not any(normalize_url(url) in known for url in urls):
            removed_lines += 1
            entry = SOURCE_ENTRY.match(line)
            if entry:
                removed_numbers.add(entry.group(1))
            continue
        sources.append(line)

    if not removed_lines:
        return text, 0

    def keep(block):
        # Findings can also follow the source list (live test: a finding written after it).
        kept = []
        for line in block:
            if SOURCE_ENTRY.match(line):
                kept.append(line)
                continue
            new_line, only_removed = strip_markers(line, removed_numbers)
            if not only_removed:
                kept.append(new_line)
        return kept

    checked = "\n".join(keep(lines[:heading]) + [lines[heading]] + keep(sources)).rstrip()
    note = f"({removed_lines} sumber dihapus karena tidak ada di hasil pencarian.)"
    return f"{checked}\n\n{note}", removed_lines


def text_contents(message):
    """Text items of a message's content blocks (flat or grouped under .contents)."""
    for block in getattr(message, "content_blocks", None) or []:
        for item in getattr(block, "contents", None) or [block]:
            if getattr(item, "type", None) == "text" and isinstance(getattr(item, "text", None), str):
                yield item


def keep_final_answer_only(message):
    """Drop the text of earlier Agent rounds; tool blocks and the final answer stay.

    Chat Output assigns Message.text, which joins every text block into one
    (live v1.9.0 test: the app then showed a tool round's text and the answer
    one after the other). With only the final answer left, the joined text is
    the answer.
    """
    blocks = getattr(message, "content_blocks", None)
    if not isinstance(blocks, list):
        return
    texts = [block for block in blocks if getattr(block, "type", None) == "text"]
    if len(texts) > 1:
        blocks[:] = [block for block in blocks if getattr(block, "type", None) != "text" or block is texts[-1]]


class CielSourceGuard(Component):
    display_name = "Ciel Source Guard"
    description = (
        "Menghapus sumber yang URL-nya tidak dikembalikan Ciel Exa Search "
        "pada run yang sama."
    )
    icon = "shield-check"
    name = "CielSourceGuard"

    inputs = [
        MessageInput(name="notes", display_name="Answer", required=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="checked_notes", method="check"),
    ]

    def check(self) -> Message:
        retrieved = self.ctx.get(RETRIEVED_URLS_KEY) or []
        message = self.notes
        if isinstance(message, str):
            message = Message(text=message)

        # Langflow 1.12 derives Message.text from the text blocks, and assigning
        # it replaces every text block with one joined block (the app would then
        # show earlier rounds too). So filter inside the blocks and assign text
        # only for a message without blocks, and only when it changed.
        removed = 0
        items = list(text_contents(message))
        for item in items:
            item.text, count = filter_sources(item.text, retrieved)
            removed += count
        if not items and isinstance(message.text, str):
            checked, removed = filter_sources(message.text, retrieved)
            if removed:
                message.text = checked
        keep_final_answer_only(message)

        self.status = f"{len(set(retrieved))} URL dari Exa, {removed} sumber dihapus."
        return message
